description: Standalone RoArm-M3 motion configuration derived from the hardware-validated legacy package.
notes: The full legacy observation joint pose B/T/R/S/E is commanded; the gripper is intentionally omitted.
Camera frames remain in the original sensor orientation; no software image rotation is applied.
No observation motion may be sent automatically at node startup.
T=104 Cartesian motion remains disabled until the observation pose test passes.
Stage 4D begins with one explicitly commanded B-only move on the persistent driver; automatic B search remains disabled until that interface test passes.
